# `dunning_setting`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

The postpaid dunning steps (one row): days after O, the first overdue date, and the smallest overdue amount that counts. The worker derives the steps from them on every pass, so a change applies to the steps not yet taken.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Always true: the table holds one row. |
| `reminder1_days` | `integer` | no | `1` | Days after O of the first reminder (email and SMS). |
| `reminder2_days` | `integer` | no | `7` | Days after O of the second reminder; greater than reminder1_days. |
| `suspend_days` | `integer` | no | `14` | Days after O on which every active product of the account is suspended through an internal order; greater than reminder2_days. |
| `minimum_overdue` | `numeric(12,2)` | no | `5.00` | In the account currency: an account owing less past due is not in dunning (no step, and its dunning suspensions are lifted). |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Last change by an operator (injected clock); null while the defaults stand. |

| `dunning_setting_minimum_overdue_check` | check | `CHECK ((minimum_overdue >= (0)::numeric))` |

| `dunning_setting_reminder2_days_check` | check | `CHECK (((reminder2_days >= 0) AND (reminder2_days <= 365)))` |
| `dunning_setting_suspend_days_check` | check | `CHECK (((suspend_days >= 0) AND (suspend_days <= 365)))` |
| `dunning_setting_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
